comment: The Spanish vector set (languages spec §6.1, Plan L4): the Spanish essential tier plus Wikipedia history (as English has) and Clásicos Granger, with set.json's caps for the same kinds of pack. Each pack is built from its _nopic file, whose snapshot matches the _maxi entry the tiers list, so catalog_gen's attach_vectors puts the vectors on both flavours (as R1 did for medicine, top and history). Snapshots are those of the catalog built from the live Kiwix feed on 2026-10-31.

keywordOnly.wikipedia_es_all: 2.1M articles, tens of millions of chunks; comprehensive only (English leaves its all and top1m out too)
keywordOnly.wiktionary_es_all_nopic: comprehensive only; short dictionary entries, as English leaves wiktionary out
keywordOnly.wikisource_es_all: comprehensive only; whole texts, too big (English leaves wikisource out)
keywordOnly.wikiquote_es_all: comprehensive only; quotes, as English's wikiquote was trimmed 2026-10-21
